chapters.title: SELL-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The drop leaves a low at 25,834.25 that no bar since has traded below: DS Parallax marks sell-side liquidity there on the 15m panel, where sell stops rest below an unswept low.

chapters.title: SELL-SIDE SWEPT
chapters.text: Price runs the sell-side pool at 25,834.25 on the 15m panel and the bar closes back above it at 25,838.75, so DS Parallax ghosts the level: a dashed trace ending in an x at the sweep.

chapters.title: SELL-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The sweep's own low, 25,817.25, is now the nearest unswept low: the 15m panel marks it as the next sell-side pool, below the ghost of the one just run.

chapters.title: BUY-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The move away from the sweep leaves a high at 25,955.00 that no bar since has traded above: the 15m panel marks buy-side liquidity there, where buy stops rest above an unswept high.
